query: SELECT so.codigoItem, DATE_FORMAT(SUBSTRING(so.dataEmissao, 1, 10), '%Y-%m') as yearMonth, SUM(so.quantidade) as totalQty FROM sales_orders so WHERE so.codigoItem IN ('00024', '00023', '00025') AND so.estadoItem IN ('Faturado', 'Faturado parcial', 'Faturado c/ entrega futura') AND SUBSTRING(so.dataEmissao, 1, 10) >= '2026-02-01' GROUP BY so.codigoItem, yearMonth ORDER BY yearMonth DESC, so.codigoItem;
